seoTitle: Remote Jobs API: RemoteOK, Remotive, Himalayas, Jobicy, WWR
seoDescription: Aggregate remote job listings from 5 public job boards into one normalized JSON dataset: title, company, salary, region, tags, apply link. $0.001 per job.

job-listed.eventDescription: One normalized remote job record written to the dataset. Sources that fail to load are reported for free.
